title: Glass Destruct By Sprint
description: Shatter through every type of glass block and pane just by sprinting! Become a human bulldozer.
body:
Turn your character into a powerhouse! Glass Destruct by Sprint is a lightweight utility mod that allows you to shatter through any glass obstacle simply by running. No more stopping to punch windows or glass walls—just sprint and keep moving!

Features
Total Destruction: Instantly breaks all types of glass when you sprint into them.

Full Support for Blocks: Works with standard Glass Blocks and all 16 colors of Stained Glass.

Full Support for Panes: Works with standard Glass Panes and all 16 colors of Stained Glass Panes.

Seamless Gameplay: Designed to let you maintain your momentum during parkour, exploration, or building.

How to use
Install the mod in your mods folder (requires Forge 1.20.1).

Launch Minecraft.

Sprint (default key: Ctrl or double-tap W) toward any glass structure.

Watch the glass shatter as you run right through it!

Technical Details
Version: 1.20.1

Loader: Forge

Category: Utility / Gameplay / Fun
